headline: Where to find Anubis in Palworld 1.0
title: Where to Find Anubis in Palworld | Alpha Boss Location | Palworld Guide
video_script: Anubis is one of the best Pals in Palworld, and here's where to find it in one point zero. The Alpha Anubis is a level fifty five field boss in the desert, just south of the Anubis Dunes fast travel point, at around minus one three four, minus nine four. It was level forty seven in early access, so it's tougher now. Bring strong spheres and a good team, and if you lose, you can try again. Got your Anubis yet? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Just south of the fast travel point

description: Palworld 1.0 Anubis location: the Alpha Anubis is a level 55 field boss just south of the Anubis Dunes fast travel point, around (-134, -94). It was level 47 in early access.
